items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: He played by himself at the Owl Theatre.

ctx.x: Well let me ask you about somebody. Did you ever know Charlie Cook? Doc Cook?

Yeah, oh God yeah. Cook, that's the greatest musician. He's one of the greatest who was in the world. Cook was. Yeah, Cook he was, oh God. He was a top guy. He was a top guy. Cook could direct you know, and play as he direct you know. Cook was a crackerjack musician, Cook was. He was one of the best. Cook was. That was Cook, Charlie Cook, yeah he was the best. He was the greatest. There was Tony Jackson, there was Cook, and there was Dave Payton, and there's a guy that played at the Owl Theatre, and what was his…
Oh plenty. Plenty, I've heard about him. Ice and Snow? Yeah. I was one of his good nombos too. You heard of Tony, huh? Oh yeah. Well a lot of guys used to talk about him.
